description: Each phase's count is its number of telescopes, and column 2 sums these counts over the above-average phases.

c.request: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Each phase's count is its number of telescopes, and column 2 sums these counts over the above-average phases.
c.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(p.phase_avg - a.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE p.phase_avg > a.mean_phase_avg

b.request: Join each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, excluding unmatched telescopes; group by `observatories.lunarstage`, with NULL as its own phase; calculate each phase’s telescope count and average non-NULL `bandusagepct`; compute the mean of the phase averages; then return one row containing the mean bandwidth average of phases above that mean, the sum of their telescope counts, and their mean excess above that mean, without rounding
b.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_bandwidth_average, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS telescope_count, AVG(p.avg_bandusagepct - m.mean_phase_avg) AS mean_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandusagepct > m.mean_phase_avg;

a.request: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), compute two things: the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`) over its telescopes, ignoring missing values, and the number of telescopes. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Return one row with three values: the average of the kept phases' bandwidth averages, the total number of telescopes across the kept phases, and the average amount by which the kept phases exceed that mean. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_kept_bandwidth, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;

d.request: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation` and discard unmatched telescopes. Group the matched telescopes by `observatories.lunarstage`, treating missing phases as a separate group. For each phase, calculate the average `telescopes.bandusagepct` while ignoring missing values, and count all telescopes in that phase. Keep only phases whose bandwidth average exceeds the mean of all phase bandwidth averages. Return one unrounded row with three values: the average of the retained phases’ bandwidth averages, the sum of their telescope counts, and the average amount by which their bandwidth averages exceed the mean.
d.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS bandwidth_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(bandwidth_avg) AS mean_bandwidth_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.bandwidth_avg) AS avg_retained_bandwidth, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(p.bandwidth_avg - m.mean_bandwidth_avg) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.bandwidth_avg > m.mean_bandwidth_avg
